# System layer, Right Option held
left           omniwmctl command focus left
shift+left     omniwmctl command move left
down           omniwmctl command focus-window-or-workspace-down
shift+down     omniwmctl command move-window-down-or-to-workspace-down
up             omniwmctl command focus-window-or-workspace-up
shift+up       omniwmctl command move-window-up-or-to-workspace-up
right          omniwmctl command focus right
shift+right    omniwmctl command move right
b              omniwmctl command switch-workspace 5
shift+b        omniwmctl command move-to-workspace 5
c              omniwmctl command switch-workspace 3
shift+c        omniwmctl command move-to-workspace 3
d              omniwmctl command toggle-overview
f              omniwmctl command open-command-palette windows
p              open -g -b com.raycast.macos
q              omniwmctl command close-focused-window
s              omniwmctl command cycle-size forward
t              omniwmctl command toggle-quake-terminal
v              omniwmctl command switch-workspace 4
shift+v        omniwmctl command move-to-workspace 4
x              omniwmctl command switch-workspace 2
shift+x        omniwmctl command move-to-workspace 2
z              omniwmctl command switch-workspace 1
shift+z        omniwmctl command move-to-workspace 1
[              omniwmctl command focus previous
]              omniwmctl command switch-workspace back-and-forth
return         omniwmctl command toggle-fullscreen
space          overlay "System  ·  locked"
tab            omniwmctl command focus-monitor next
shift+tab      omniwmctl query displays --fields frame,is-current
padenter       omniwmctl command toggle-fullscreen
